label: 14 November 2026
title: Yamal cleared for England; club closes €300m Camp Nou bond
deck: Lamine Yamal is in Spain camp and available for Sunday’s Nations League match against England. The club has finalised a €300 million bond issue to finish the Spotify Camp Nou works.

stories.headline: Yamal arrives in Spain camp and is cleared for England
stories.summary: Lamine Yamal joined Spain’s training camp in Las Rozas on Friday after individual work on his right knee in Barcelona. Luis de la Fuente said the forward is in perfect condition and ready to play the full 90 minutes against England on Sunday at the Metropolitano. Yamal missed Thursday’s 2-0 win over Czechia.
stories.body: Yamal finished the 2-1 win at Atlético Madrid with discomfort in his right knee. Medical checks showed inflammation and fluid, so the decision was taken with the club’s medical staff to keep him in Barcelona rather than travel to Prague. De la Fuente told Spanish television that Yamal feels very good now and was looking forward to joining the group. Mikel Oyarzabal, who stayed in San Sebastián for the birth of his second child, also returned. Spain have already qualified for the quarter-finals and lead the group by three points. A draw against England at the Metropolitano would secure top spot. The forward has started every previous match this season for club and country before the Czechia absence. Official footage showed him arriving at the concentration.

stories.headline: Barcelona finalises €300 million bond for Camp Nou completion
stories.summary: FC Barcelona has completed a €300 million bond issue to fund the remaining renovation work on Spotify Camp Nou. Goldman Sachs acted as sole placement agent and the CNMV approved the transaction. The club said the money will help finish the Espai Barça centrepiece, delayed to the 2028-29 season.
stories.body: The operation was approved by the general assembly in September with 90.79 per cent of the votes. It sits alongside a separate €210 million senior debt package already secured. The additional funding covers cash-flow shortfalls after rising construction costs and an expanded project scope. The stadium is scheduled for full completion in the first half of 2028 after the roof is installed in 2027. UEFA has already selected Camp Nou to host the 2029 Champions League final. The club’s statement described the transformed ground as the largest-capacity football stadium in Europe, with an expanded premium and hospitality offer. Official posts from the club confirmed the closing of the issue on Friday.

stories.headline: Raphinha captains Brazil against Japan and says he wants to be available for both
stories.summary: Carlo Ancelotti has given Raphinha the captain’s armband for Brazil’s friendly against Japan in Singapore today. The forward, speaking almost in tears, said he wants to be available for both Brazil and Barcelona after questions about managing his minutes.
stories.body: Marquinhos is unavailable through injury, so Ancelotti followed the established hierarchy and handed the armband to the number 10. Raphinha underwent ear surgery the day after the Clásico so he could travel with the national team and has played with head protection since. He leads the Pichichi race with 15 league goals and signed a new contract until 2030 last week. In the press conference he stressed that his commitment to Brazil does not conflict with his club. Gabriel Magalhães has defended his teammate’s attitude publicly. Brazil face Japan at 11:15 CET at the National Stadium in Singapore, then Singapore on Tuesday. The forward is expected back in Barcelona next week and available for Villarreal on 22 November.

stories.headline: Vicky López suffers setback and faces six to eight more weeks out
stories.summary: Vicky López will be out for another six to eight weeks after a reagudisation of the muscular injury in her right thigh. The club said new tests showed an unsatisfactory evolution of the rectus femoris problem first reported in late September.
stories.body: López has not played since 18 September. The original prognosis on 23 September was two weeks for a myofibrillar injury of the right rectus anterior. She was expected to return around the Clásico but continued to feel discomfort. Pere Romeu’s side already lacks Kerolin and Kika Nazareth for similar periods. The new timeline pushes her return into the new year. The medical staff set the longer period to guarantee full recovery and avoid further setbacks. Official communication from the club on Friday confirmed the updated recovery window. The midfielder has been watching recent matches from the stands at Camp Nou.

stories.headline: Olmo targets return against Villarreal after the break
stories.summary: Dani Olmo is progressing well from the adductor injury suffered against PSG and is expected to be available for the first match after the international break. Mundo Deportivo reported that the staff believe he can face Villarreal at Camp Nou on 22 November.
stories.body: Olmo left the field in the 27th minute of the Champions League defeat at Paris Saint-Germain on 20 October. He has missed the Clásico, Alavés, Aston Villa and Atlético Madrid. The recovery has been positive in recent days and the technical staff do not want to rush him. If a midweek fixture had been scheduled before Villarreal he could have been considered. His return would give Hansi Flick another option in midfield alongside Pedri and Fermín. The next La Liga match is at home to Villarreal on 22 November. Olmo has already reached 100 appearances for the club.

stories.headline: Raphinha faces Japan today while Spain prepare for England on Sunday
stories.summary: Raphinha captains Brazil against Japan in Singapore this afternoon. On Sunday Spain host England at the Metropolitano with Yamal available, while other Barça internationals continue their Nations League and friendly programmes.
stories.body: The club’s international diary lists five Spain players (Yamal, Pedri, Joan Garcia, Fermín and Cubarsí), Raphinha with Brazil, Gordon with England, De Jong with the Netherlands, Cancelo with Portugal, Livaković with Croatia and Bernal with the U21s. Spain beat Czechia 2-0 on Thursday with Cubarsí playing the full match and Fermín starting. England beat Croatia 2-1. Netherlands host Greece on Friday night. Portugal face Denmark on Saturday. The next club session is expected after the weekend fixtures. Non-internationals remain in Barcelona until Monday. Flick has the full group available for Villarreal preparation once the break ends on 22 November.

stories.headline: Barça Legends face Ajax Legends this weekend at Camp Nou
stories.summary: With no first-team fixture, the club is promoting the Barça Legends match against Ajax Legends at Spotify Camp Nou. Tickets are included as a benefit for members.
stories.body: The official account posted on Friday that there is an alternative plan for the weekend. The Legends fixture is part of the ongoing engagement while the senior squad is on international duty. The club has used the Camp Nou pitch for several events during the renovation phase. Members can access the match as part of their benefits. The promotion follows the 1-1 Femení draw with Arsenal earlier in the week and the financing announcement for the stadium works.

stories.headline: Ter Stegen leaves door open to a return after Ajax loan
stories.summary: Marc-André ter Stegen said it is too early to decide his long-term future and that he has not spoken recently with Hansi Flick. The goalkeeper, on loan at Ajax until the end of the season, remains in occasional contact with Barcelona players.
stories.body: Ter Stegen told COPE that he has not been in contact with Flick recently but still speaks from time to time with some of the squad. He follows the club’s results and watches matches when they do not clash with Ajax. He spent 12 years at Barcelona before the loan. His Barcelona contract runs until 2028 and there is no option to buy in the Ajax deal. He described November as too early to determine what happens next summer. The goalkeeper is currently Germany’s number one under Klopp for the national team.
